text: alignair predict: Hugging Face token for a private/gated repo (falls back to $HF_TOKEN, then $HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN)

title: --input
text: alignair predict: reads to align (FASTA / FASTQ / TSV; .gz ok; '-' = stdin)

title: --out
text: alignair predict: output AIRR TSV path

text: alignair predict: sequence column name (CSV/TSV input)

title: --id-column
text: alignair predict: id column name (CSV/TSV input)

title: --rejects-out
text: alignair predict: write dropped/invalid input records here (id, position, reason, sequence)

title: --locus
text: alignair predict: locus label for records the model can't attribute (default: the model's locus if it declares exactly one; else IGH). With several loci, each

title: --no-run-metadata
text: alignair predict: do not write the <out>.run.json sidecar

title: --columns
text: alignair predict: output columns: a preset (full/core/minimal/airr) or a comma-separated field list (default: full). Light selections skip the AIRR assembly f

title: --metadata
text: alignair predict: per-read metadata table (e.g. 10x filtered_contig_annotations.csv / an AIRR TSV) to join by id and carry into output (cell_id/barcode/umi_co

title: --metadata-id-column
text: alignair predict: id column in the --metadata table

title: --keep-columns
text: alignair predict: comma-separated metadata columns to carry through (default: known 10x/AIRR set)

title: --genotype
text: alignair predict: a donor's genotype: JSON/YAML {V|D|J: [allele names]} or the AIRR GenotypeSet `alignair genotype` writes; calls come only from its alleles,

title: --reference
text: alignair predict: germline FASTA (V, D and J alleles) to call from, novel alleles included. Missing IMGT gaps and anchors are taken from the model's own refer

title: --infer-genotype
text: alignair predict: infer the donor's V genotype from the reads' own calls (TIgGER's frequency rule on the reads whose V call is a single allele) and re-call th

title: --genotype-out
text: alignair predict: where --infer-genotype writes the genotype, an AIRR GenotypeSet (default: <out>.genotype.json)

title: --genotype-explain
text: alignair predict: --infer-genotype: the share of a gene's single-allele reads its alleles explain (default 0.875)

title: --genotype-min-reads
text: alignair predict: --infer-genotype: the single-allele reads a gene needs to be genotyped; a gene with fewer keeps every allele (default 10)

title: --device
text: alignair predict: cpu / cuda / mps / auto (default: auto: CUDA, then Apple MPS, then CPU)

title: --batch-size
text: alignair predict: reads per batch (default: 256 on a GPU, 16 per worker with --threads on the CPU, else 64)

title: --threads
text: alignair predict: CPU threads: on the CPU, N worker processes of one thread each (torch's threads scale poorly on read batches); on a GPU, torch's CPU threads

title: --chunk-size
text: alignair predict: stream the input in chunks of this many reads (default 20000)

title: --max-assembly-failures
text: alignair predict: fail the job if the AIRR-assembly FAILURE rate exceeds this fraction (default 0.01); failures are always tagged per row regardless

title: --max-partial-assemblies
text: alignair predict: fail the job if the PARTIAL-assembly rate exceeds this fraction (default 1.0 = never; partial rows are always tagged with a reason)

title: --permissive
text: alignair predict: never fail on assembly failure/partial rates (dirty repertoires); still tags rows

title: --quiet
text: alignair predict: suppress the update-available notice

title: --debug
text: alignair predict: include the full exception traceback on errors

title: --error-format
text: alignair predict: runtime error format on stderr (default: text)

title: sequence_id
text: The read's id: the input record's id (a repeated id gets a _dupN suffix), or the --id-column value of a table.

title: sequence
text: The read as aligned (cut to its first 575 nt when longer); for a reverse-complement read, the original read (see rev_comp).

title: rev_comp
text: T when the read was reverse-complemented to align: coordinates and alignments then refer to the reverse complement of sequence.

title: locus
text: The locus of the V call (IGH, IGK, IGL, TRA, TRB, TRD or TRG); a model of one locus writes it for every read.

title: v_call
text: The V allele call; alleles that match the read equally well follow it, comma-separated (IgBLAST's convention).

title: d_call
text: The D allele call; alleles that match the read equally well follow it, comma-separated (IgBLAST's convention).

title: j_call
text: The J allele call; alleles that match the read equally well follow it, comma-separated (IgBLAST's convention).

title: c_call
text: The constant-region gene. AlignAIR does not call it; a --metadata table may fill it (10x c_gene).

title: productive
text: T when the rearrangement is productive: V and J in frame, no stop codon, conserved junction anchors.

title: productive_prediction
text: The same call as productive, kept for tools that read this column.

title: vj_in_frame
text: T when V and J are in the same reading frame.

title: stop_codon
text: T when the aligned sequence holds a stop codon in the V reading frame.

title: v_identity
text: The fraction of the aligned V bases that match the germline.

title: d_identity
text: The fraction of the aligned D bases that match the germline.

title: j_identity
text: The fraction of the aligned J bases that match the germline.

title: sequence_alignment
text: The aligned read, IMGT-gapped (dots in the V gaps).

title: germline_alignment
text: The germline the read aligns to, IMGT-gapped, position for position with sequence_alignment (N in the junction's untemplated bases).

title: sequence_alignment_aa
text: sequence_alignment translated.

title: germline_alignment_aa
text: germline_alignment translated.

title: junction
text: The junction: CDR3 with its conserved anchors (V's Cys to J's Trp or Phe).

title: junction_aa
text: The junction translated (X for an incomplete codon).

title: junction_length
text: The junction's length in nucleotides.

title: junction_aa_length
text: The junction's length in amino acids.

title: np1
text: The untemplated bases between V and D (between V and J without a D).

title: np1_length
text: The length of np1.

title: np2
text: The untemplated bases between D and J.

title: np2_length
text: The length of np2.

title: v_cigar
text: The V alignment of the read against its germline, as a CIGAR string.

title: d_cigar
text: The D alignment of the read against its germline, as a CIGAR string.

title: j_cigar
text: The J alignment of the read against its germline, as a CIGAR string.
